title: Meridian site visit
text: Okay, note from the Memphis visit, August 28. Two things. First, on drivers: the two terminals that kept their dispatchers through the reorg are both running turnover under 35 percent. The ones that rotated dispatchers are at 50 plus. Ortega's team is talking about pay, but I think dispatch tenure is the lever. Put that on the bench. Second, the warehouse pilot: equipment is in, it looks good, but the integration with the warehouse system is not on the schedule yet. The September throughput read may come off a manual count. Worth asking Renee about before the board call. That's it.
